final: WITH country_stats AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) as country_tally FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), totals AS (SELECT SUM(country_tally) as overall_total, AVG(country_tally) as average_tally FROM country_stats), above_avg AS (SELECT cs.country_tally, cs.country_tally * 1.0 / (SELECT overall_total FROM totals) as share, cs.country_tally - (SELECT average_tally FROM totals) as above_avg_amount FROM country_stats cs WHERE cs.country_tally > (SELECT average_tally FROM totals)) SELECT SUM(country_tally) as combined_tally, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(above_avg_amount) as avg_above_average FROM above_avg
